issue.title: Fix AIOOB on indexed geo_shape query

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This change fixes a possible AIOOB during the parsing of the document that contains the indexed shape.
This change ensures that the parsing does not continue when the field that contains the shape has been found.

Closes #28456

body: This is a bug introduced in 6.0 that appears when more than one `geo_shape` query need to fetch pre-indexed shapes in an index. There is a race condition that can lead to an AIOOBE. I opened https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/28458 to fix it.
Awesome, thanks for the quick response and fix! Will this make it into ES 6.3?

issue.title: ElasticSearch 5.3 returns 0 hits under high concurrency conditions

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
**Elasticsearch version**: 5.3

**Plugins installed**: [Kibana]

**JVM version** (`java -version`): 1.8

**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system): AWS ElasticSearch service

Cluster size:
4 i3.2xlarge.elasticsearch worker nodes
2 shards/index
Index size: ~50-60GB primary

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:
Under high concurrency conditions on a Spark EMR cluster, elasticsearch returns 0 hits for a query that would succeed otherwise. The query we are using involves geospatial joins across pre-indexed geoshapes.
We retry the requests when encountering this condition and the retries sometimes work, sometimes not.

**Steps to reproduce**:
Attached sample query
